# Fixture provenance

sample.iso is an original REAzip test fixture generated with pycdlib 1.14.0. It contains only SAMPLE.TXT with the exact bytes `REAzip full engine ISO fixture\n`. It contains no third-party software or personal data. Its purpose is to prove the full 7-Zip library exposes a format unavailable in the standalone reduced 7za build.

Archive tests generate their other input/output files in dedicated temporary build directories. The fixture itself and its original text may be used under the repository MIT license.
